instructions_to_agent: Work only in C:\Users\hooki\df2-workstation. Read AGENTS.md and FILTER_NOTEBOOK.md first.
Every fact below is OBSERVED from code/tests as of commit e5015a08 unless marked otherwise. Verify against code before relying on line-level details.
Nonlinear stages have no transfer function. Plots gate linear claims only; driven sound is gated by level-matched renders and Tyson's ear.
One change per verdict. Build to a hearable render, deliver, wait.
Renders must warm-start (hd_ab does a discarded full pass first). Level-match every A/B — the HD leveller alone is worth ~+0.7 dB.

defaults.island_rate: 78125 Hz (hdMode=true DEFAULT). 39062.5 kept as compatibility fallback (hdMode=false). Bytes on disk are ALWAYS authored at 39062.5; HD is a decode-time re-derivation at load.
defaults.slamDrive: 0.10 — output desk on by default, tame. 0.5 approved as 'insane' flavor, reachable by wheel.
defaults.bite: 0.0 — the linear cascade, bit-exact. Bodies ship as authored; NO FILTER and utilities stay honest. Nonzero bite is per-preset seasoning or user's hand, NEVER a global default.
defaults.keyTrack: false (host param, no face control yet)
defaults.amount: 1.0, morph 0.5, q 0.0, body 0 (NO FILTER), motion off, space 0

laws: NO NEW UI ELEMENTS — the face is locked (Tyson, 2026-07-18). Every feature must surface through existing controls (TYPE list, MORPH/Q wheels, AMOUNT, the MOVE chips, hidden host params) or per-body baked behavior. A feature that needs a new control does not ship until it doesn't.
body240 format is immutable: 4 corners x 6 stages x 5 u16 words, authored at 39062.5. HD never touches disk bytes.

The roster imprints TIMBRE, never harmony. No chord/scale bodies in the roster (Phrygian was built, gated clean, and pulled on this rule). Chord-body pipeline lives in dev/tmp/bytes_fix for a future on-demand catalog.
Every option (bite, hdMode off, keyTrack, inputMode SLAM) must null bit-exact / byte-identical when disabled. All current ones are test-proven.
PresetRoster.inc is never regenerated without re-appending the hand-added tail (demo six + De-Esser + De-Mudder).
Gate chord/resonator bodies on DECODED POLE ANGLES (packed_probe -> acos), never on cascade magnitude maxima: half-step neighbours merge into one peak.
interpolate_biquad returns BIQUAD rows -> evaluate with response::biquad_*_mag_db, never kernel_*.
Coefficient-ramp convergence is geometric: probe runtime coefficients only after ~250k samples or mid-ramp values masquerade as math errors.

KeyTrackDetector (if keyTrack): YIN on 4x-decimated ring, hop 512, pitch-class snap C-anchor +-6 semi, debounce 2, silence holds -> params.pitchRatio
applyMotion: motion tiles / react push (baked-react bodies push Q with motion fully off) -> morph/q
params: bite -> interstageDrive; ParamID::bite post-cascade biteDriveBlock held at 0
island: FixedRateTrenchIsland.prepare(hostRate, blockSize, bridge, islandRate) — islandRate from hdMode at prepareToPlay; latency reported to host
anti-fold guard: elliptic LP, stopband at islandRate/2, passband fold-2031.25 Hz, active only when hostNyquist > fold (bypassSRC when host==island rate)
engine_per_sample (trench-core FilterEng: 1. input stage: InputMode None (default) | MackieDeskSlam (into-filter desk, slam_drive ramped per control block; plugin scales param by kIntoFilterDriveScale=0.10) | Cvsd

3. cascade L/R: 6 DF2T stages, per-sample coefficient ramp toward per-control-block targets (32-sample grid, phase-continuous). KEY TRACK transpose applied at interpolation (set_parameters: conjugate pairs root-factored, angle *= ratio clamped 0.5..2.0, radius kept, before AMOUNT taper; ratio 1.0 branches out bit-exact). AMOUNT taper after transpose. BITE: mackity_saturate (x - 0.1768 x^5) at the 5 inter-stage junctions, drive into curve g = 1 + 7*drive, unity-compensated, per-sample ramped; drive 0 branches to the untouched linear loop
4. AGC: table leveller (agc_drive=2.0 pre-scale law), active_agc_table(rate) — >65k uses the sqrt table (the DLL's own rate law, so HD gets authentic successor behavior)
7. saturate() output soft-knee (safety, transparent below knee)
engine_per_block_post: QSound spatial (SpatialMode::QSound when space > 0): measured re-capture, shelf corners 513/1816 Hz, width guard keeps lows mono (process_block tail, engine.rs ~808)
plugin_post: MOVE guard duck (up to -5 dB at gesture peak)
SLAM: Mackie output desk (Airwindows Mackity model) at host rate, applied ONCE, final audible operation. Default drive 0.10

beyond_body240.context: Runtime headroom is proven far beyond one cascade (~100 biquads is comfortable). Two lanes: COMPOSE existing 240-byte bodies at runtime (no format change), or EXTEND the format (V2). The 6-stage body240 itself stays immutable either way.

compose_no_format_change.note: Two bodies in series (12 biquads): utility-into-character in one instance (De-Esser -> Talker). One hidden second slot. Highest usability-per-line-of-code.
Body-to-body morph (12 biquads): MORPH travels BETWEEN two loaded bodies via z_crossfade (implemented+tested in minifloat.rs). The preset list becomes a space.
3-5 detuned copies of one body (24-60 biquads), cents-spread, summed — the filter supersaw. Stereo bloom (L/R cent offset via existing pitch_ratio machinery) is the 2-voice starter.

extend_format_v2.note: A bodyN format (e.g. 12-24 stages/corner, 'body960') fits REAL measured objects — guitar body, cymbal, cab, room modes — as morphing cascades. 'Put your drums inside a grand piano', from measurements. The whole authoring/certify/decode pipeline generalizes; only the byte layout and grid-certification budget change.

Measured-ear spatial: fit HRTF magnitude trajectories (SONICOM, 403 subjects, already on disk at dev/tmp/hrtf/sonicom) as morphing cascades — ORBIT graduates from psychoacoustic QSound to real elevation/azimuth. Needs the bodyN lane above.
Crossover split, one body per band (3x6 biquads + guards): mud body on lows / character mids / open top — TRENCH as a master-bus device. Furthest from current product shape; park last.

beyond_body240.restraint: None of these enter V1. RACK and Z_CUBE are the first two post-ship builds; format extensions wait for a V2 decision. Catalog-lane chord generation (see next_missions_ranked) composes with all of them.
